prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent arena sprite atlas for a browser game. Generate EXACTLY 24 isolated simple game sprites in a strict aligned grid of FOUR columns and SIX rows, large portrait image aspect 2:3. Every sprite fully inside its own square cell and surrounded by a generous completely empty transparent margin of 22% ON EACH EDGE of the cell. No object, sparkle, shadow or tip may cross this margin. Keep each object small enough for these gutters; no overlaps. Objects are meant to be readable at 24-48 pixels and must be MUCH SIMPLER than ornate inventory illustrations. Style: The original warm dimensional fantasy game style: smooth cartoon painting, simple clean outlines, warm golden highlights. Red, blue, green, orange, brown readable solid masses. Very simple rounded objects; only 2-3 broad tonal areas per object. No detailed textures, no filigree, no detached particles, no decorative glow cloud, no props, no cell boxes, no labels, no numbers, no text, no background. Exact reading order left to right, top to bottom:
1. one simple icy blue crystal cluster, upright
2. one steel fishing hook with a teal handle, attachment upper right and hook point lower left
3. one red ivory gold rocket, nose to upper right at 45 degrees and flame at lower left
4. one brown leather boxing glove facing upper right at 60 degrees
5. one pale violet web with exactly six broad spokes
6. one green poison bottle with a simple pale skull mark
7. one dark round mine with six broad gold studs
8. one gold padlock with blue enamel keyhole
9. one long silver harpoon with wood handle pointing to upper right 45 degrees
10. one blue steel double axe with short wood handle pointing upper right 60 degrees
11. one plain chunky slate stone with a single broad facet
12. one brass four-loop knuckle duster pointing upper right 60 degrees
13. one darker emerald poison flask with one skull mark and no extra jewels
14. one bold orange yellow flame pointing UP, three main tongues only
15. one little round purple icing cake with one red cherry
16. one steel awl with dark blue handle pointing upper right 45 degrees
17. one short silver sword with simple orange flame edge pointing upper right 45 degrees
18. one gold crescent claw pointing upper right 45 degrees
19. one brown glove with three silver claws pointing upper right 45 degrees
20. one round green arena thorn with twelve broad triangular spikes and simple inner highlight
21. one RED Easter egg with one simple gold zigzag band
22. one BLUE Easter egg with one simple gold dot band
23. one GREEN Easter egg with one simple gold leaf band
24. one ORANGE Easter egg with one simple gold sun band
The four eggs must have natural near-round egg proportions, not thin stretched eggs. Preserve exact orientation of each directional weapon. Fully transparent alpha background.
note: Упрощение бустеров отменено владельцем во время генерации. Первые 19 рисунков не подключены. Использованы только колючка и четыре коллекционных яйца.
